name: Joshua Aaron Rotenberg
headline: Local SEO Specialist — Google Business Profile & Listings Management
summary: Local SEO specialist with 4 years of hands-on SEO experience rooted in Google Business Profile and local-listings work. At Solenzo, GBP setup and optimization is the first deliverable in every client engagement; at Birdeye, selling and onboarding partners onto a proprietary data-aggregator/listings solution was the backbone of the offer, and the start of my career in local search. Backs that with technical SEO depth (Screaming Frog, schema, Ahrefs, Semrush) and 15+ years owning client relationships end to end.

Conduct technical SEO audits, keyword gap analyses, and competitor research using Screaming Frog for site-wide SEO data pulls, implementing fixes directly inside client CMS platforms.
Identify and implement schema/structured data as part of technical SEO audits, pulling full on-page schema implementation.

Built automated review-generation sequences and segmented outreach campaigns (including low-reviews campaigns) as part of a 20+ workflow GoHighLevel marketing-automation system for local service businesses.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Ran Google keyword research and search-term analysis to shape campaign targeting and content direction.

Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners (deal sizes ~$10K-$45K, spanning health, home services, and retail verticals), retaining all but one (~94% retention).
